NVIDIA CUDA Runtime (cudart64_12.dll)
=====================================

Domino Player optionally redistributes the NVIDIA CUDA Runtime library to support
zero-copy D3D11 output for TensorRT. The library is not required when the
TensorRT path is unavailable; playback falls back to CPU/SR paths.

Source package: nvidia-cuda-runtime-cu12 12.9.79 (Windows x64 wheel)
License: NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit End User License Agreement (EULA)
https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/eula/index.html

The CUDA Runtime is loaded dynamically by src/trt/gpu_interop.cpp.
